author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.15.0 — Fixes notifications silently not firing (and the dynamic poll interval flapping back to idle mid-clean): polling now trusts the app's own active-run tracking, not just the latest single poll's status reading, so a short single-room clean can no longer land entirely between two idle-interval polls unnoticed, and one noisy poll reading can no longer knock fast polling back to slow. Also enriches notification content: 'cleaning started' now names the room(s) being cleaned, 'cleaning finished' now breaks down which rooms were confirmed cleaned vs. not completed. Adds a log.info line recording each single-room dispatch's measured clean time.
